text:
alex: quick follow-up on the multi-tenant hotpath eviction orchestration spike. want consensus on who owns the hotpath eviction decision: local node or centralized orchestrator? i sketched tradeoffs.
maria: local wins on immediate latency but struggles with cross-tenant fairness. hybrid?
jordan: hybrid seems reasonable. local handles immediate evicts, orchestrator triggers slower rebalances for global QoS.
samir: +1. how do we prevent oscillation when orchestrator nudges the same hot prefix between nodes? need cooldown/backoff.
lee: leaning toward lease + cooldown. lease ttl ~30s, cooloff 60s. orchestrator requests handoff, target accepts only if hot_prefix_score > threshold.
alex: quick config sketch: 
```
evict:
  handoff_lease_s: 30
  handoff_cooldown_s: 60
  hot_score_threshold: 0.75
```
maria: metrics to add before rollout: handoff_attempts_total, handoff_failures, evict_local_latency_ms, global_rebalance_count, tenant_cache_pct. also add a histogram for handoff_latency_ms.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary plan: enable orchestrator rebalances on 5% of clusters. /deploy canary=hot-evict-orch
jordan: correctness note: handoff must be idempotent. assign handoff_uuid and apply CAS on ownership record to avoid double-apply races.
samir: another race: two orchestrators could attempt the same handoff. ensure single leader or attach epoch and reject if epoch < current. consistent hashing can reduce contention.
alex: open questions i want input on: 1) signal composition for hot_prefix_score (current: qps * recency_decay / resident_bytes) 2) demote vs hard-evict thresholds 3) operational playbook for stuck handoffs (manual revoke vs force-steal)
maria: propose canary test plan: synthetic hot tenants, trigger handoff, validate missing reads < 1% and p95 latency within SLO. add smoke check to ensure no tenant exceeds cache_pct_limit.
lee: small UX ask: console should expose pending handoffs with reason, initiator, and age. ops needs easy abort.
alex: i'll write a short RFC update with the config + test plan + metrics. will push a draft later today. thanks all :thumbsup:
